subject: Export formats, handover timelines and certificate for access/audit logs
messages:
From: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acmefinancial.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procure-acme <procure@acmefinancial.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Export formats and retention: access/audit logs for legal hold

Hi Ben,

We're starting legal hold planning for a small set of users and need to confirm what you can provide for access and audit logs. A few concrete asks:

- Minimum retention window available for tenant-level audit logs?
- What export formats do you support (CSV, JSON, gzipped bundles)? Any field-level differences between formats?
- Can you provide a time-bound bulk export (e.g., two-week slice) on short notice and what's the lead time?
- Do you provide a signed certificate of deletion/handback when logs are transferred back to the customer? If so, what's the content?

We may need an evidence package for compliance (SOC2 review) and a certificate for chain-of-custody. Please include any standard templates you use.

Thanks,
Jamie
Jamie Torres
Head of Security & Compliance
Acme Financial

--

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acmefinancial.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Export formats and retention: access/audit logs for legal hold

Hi Jamie — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, full details below and I've looped in Marissa (CS) and Neha (Security) for specifics and timeline.

- Retention: Hosted tenants default to 90 days for access/audit logs; Dedicated and Private deployments can be configured up to 7 years depending on contract.
- Formats: We support ndjson (newline-delimited JSON) gzipped, CSV extracts (flattened) and an AVRO-style bundle for large exports. Field parity is maintained for primary audit fields (timestamp, user_id, actor_ip, action, target_resource, request_id); CSV includes flattened nested fields with column prefixes.
- Lead time: For slices under 30 days we can typically deliver within 48–72 hours for hosted; Dedicated/Private depends on access (48–96 hours).
- Certificate: We can provide an export manifest plus a signed handback statement (PKI-signed) that lists file checksums (SHA256), export window, delivered formats, and a deletion attestation for any retained intermediate artifacts.

Attachments: I will attach a sample manifest and a small sample bundle.

Next steps: Marissa will coordinate scheduling and S3/GCS transfer details; Neha will confirm the PKI certificate process and sign-off language.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: sample_access_log.json.gz (gz, 8KB)
Attachment: audit_export_manifest.csv (CSV, 4KB)

--

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Export formats and retention: access/audit logs for legal hold

Ben / team,

Confirming operational details for Acme:

- Export workflow: For hosted tenants we run an extraction job that writes a gzipped ndjson bundle to a pre-authorized S3 presigned URL (or GCS signed URL) you provide. We create one bundle per day-range chunk (configurable).
- File naming: redwood-<tenant>-audit-YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD.ndjson.gz, manifest file lists SHA256 per file.
- Field set: The manifest includes schema version, fields shipped, total records, and compression details. CSV extracts are produced from the same canonical stream and will include metadata columns (request_id, event_index) to map back to the raw events.
- Lead time & scheduling: We can queue an ad-hoc job within 24 hours if it's under 14 days of log data; for longer windows or larger volumes we need 72 hours.
- Intermediate retention: Temporary staging for export artifacts is kept for up to 7 days post-delivery to allow retries. We will delete staging copies once delivery confirmed and include deletion time in the handback certificate.

Neha — can you confirm the exact wording we should use for the PKI-signed handback statement and whether Legal wants the cert to include a nonce/token to tie to DocuSign or an internal ticket?

Marissa
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

--
